name: second_peer_pop_without_any_acceptance
source_basis: Per-reason receive/accepted edges omit peer identity and use moving count, while consumed edge includes full move. A +X then B -X can hide B receive/accept but emit B consumption. Both counters/latest must advance; when they remain1 after B binding there was no B acceptance to populate its empty queue.
